title: Measure the three gate shapes and publish one record
question: does the archive move delete a path a committed suite resolves, does the milestone range carry what a task log claims, and does the recorded stream carry a terminal for a navigation id that has already ended?
verdict: all three measurements examined a non-zero number of inputs at this head: the archive-reference rule has one reference decided each way in the tree it must police, the fix-record rule has a claim its own range does not carry beside a rename the same command shape records as two names, and the recorded stream carries a skipped navigation the narrator drops today
